content:
“Dominate the Wasteland with inpunity.”

**Power User** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Fusion cores now last longer.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Fusion Core duration is now doubled. | 0027A875 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Fusion Cores now last 60% longer. | 0027A874 | 
| ★ | 1 | Fusion Cores now last 30% longer. | 0027A873 | 

- Both power armor and gatling lasers benefit from this perk, as both use fusion cores.
 - This perk also affects the drain rate the jet pack modification has on fusion cores.
- This perk is less useful for those who have a lot of fusion cores in their inventory, and taking the perk can be skipped by either simply farming fusion cores from a power plant or from crafting with flux.

There are two cut ranks of this perk in the game's data. The fourth rank made fusion cores last 80% longer, while the fifth rank made fusion cores last twice as long, which effectively became the current third rank.
